digest.component_or_area: plan-review coaching moves, overlay-driven criterion configuration
propositions: When a plan's source-code references are enumerated by hand or incompletely rather than derived from the symbol graph, a project-only advisory criterion should trigger a coaching move directing re-derivation with Serena's symbol tools.

The criterion must route to plan_review only (not code_review) because project.* criterion ids cannot fire code-review moves—code-review's applies_when vocabulary is closed to {OVERLAY_IDS ∪ 'always'}, whereas plan_review merges project criteria into triggers.

Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven (load_move_registry reads .rebar/code_review_moves.json), so no engine wiring changes are required; the overlay configuration only requires three files in .rebar/ and prompts/.

The criterion must be advisory via default_posture: 'advisory' with no inert blocking_enabled key, and the move template must include both LSP-resolvable symbol-reference sites and string-literal sweeps (monkeypatch.setattr/getattr/importlib) that the LSP cannot resolve.

The coaching move's applicability is deterministically testable; however, whether the coach LLM selects it depends on LLM decision-making and competing moves, and incomplete inventories also fire blocking built-ins (G1G2, G6, E4) which take selection priority.

Live testing across seven runs confirmed the criterion fires reliably at validity 1.0 on hand-enumerated incomplete plans and correctly abstains on complete inventories; the move is proven applicable but the overlay cannot guarantee LLM selection.
